decisions.statement: A character with no target build wants no consumable.
The wanted list and the stock are worked out by the code the web matcher uses.
Item stock and wanted lists are answered as plain objects keyed by item id.
An account holds one inventory, the one its last reading wrote.
Only the keys a read uses are asked of an account row.
An inventory that cannot be read is answered as a failure rather than raised.
A failure names the snapshot at fault and the reason that snapshot is at fault.
Buy stock is unavailable and empty where no snapshot could be read.
An account holding no inventory settings at all is answered an empty rule set.
Inventory settings the shape refuses raise, naming every field at fault.
A raise leaves the config the addon holds as it is and writes no settings back.
The character reader and the inventory row reader are handed in rather than fixed.
Settings carrying no rules are read as an empty rule set, the rules being pages.

definition: the consumables a build asks for, the stock held of them, and the account inventory behind both
